claims.claim_text: Electric Boat is the prime contractor and lead shipyard on all Navy nuclear-powered submarine programs, with 14 Virginia-class submarines in backlog (Blocks IV and V) scheduled for delivery and a production cadence target of up to two Virginia-class per year.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Electric Boat
claims.object_value: Virginia-class submarine program (Blocks IV/V, 14 boats backlog)
claims.source_quote: Electric Boat is the prime contractor and lead shipyard on all Navy nuclear-powered submarine programs ... The Navy procures Virginia-class submarines in multi-boat blocks. Along with an industry partner, we are currently working on Blocks IV and V in the program, with 14 Virginia-class submarines in our backlog scheduled for delivery ... sustained production of one Columbia-class submarine plus up to two Virginia-class submarines per year

claims.claim_text: Columbia-class ballistic-missile submarine is a 12-boat program holding the highest government acquisition priority rating; GD plans to sustain one Columbia per year.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Electric Boat
claims.source_quote: The Columbia-class ballistic-missile submarine is a 12-boat program considered one of the nation's top acquisition priorities. Accordingly, the program has received the highest possible rating from the gove[rnment] ... sustained production of one Columbia-class submarine plus up to two Virginia-class submarines per year

claims.claim_text: GD received $20.1 billion of combined U.S. Navy awards for Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine programs in 2025, with $1 billion for next-generation Abrams main battle tanks.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Marine Systems & Combat Systems
claims.object_value: $20.1B sub awards + $1B next-gen Abrams + $9.2B intl wheeled/tracked
claims.source_quote: Several significant contract awards received in our defense segments, including $20.1 billion of combined awards from the U.S. Navy for the Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine programs and $9.2 billion of combined awards for wheeled and tracked vehicles for international customers ... $1 billion for next-generation Abrams main battle tanks

claims.claim_text: GD Land Systems is the sole-source producer of the Abrams main battle tank and is currently working with the Army on the next-generation M1E3 Abrams.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Land Systems
claims.source_quote: Land Systems is the sole-source producer of two foundational products central to the U.S. Army's warfighting capabilities — the Abrams main battle tank and Stryker wheeled combat vehicle ... We are currently working with the Army to develop the next generation M1E3 Abrams tank

claims.claim_text: GD Land Systems is sole-source producer of the Stryker, but 2025 U.S. military vehicle revenue declined due to the termination of the M10 Booker program and lower Stryker volumes (offset partly by XM30).
claims.subject: General Dynamics Land Systems
claims.source_quote: Revenue from U.S. military vehicles decreased in 2025 due primarily to the termination of the M10 Booker program and lower volume on Stryker programs, partially offset by higher volume on the XM30 program.

claims.claim_text: XM30 mechanized infantry combat vehicle program-of-record (Bradley replacement) is in development and shows higher volume in 2025; framed as a forward growth driver.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Land Systems
claims.source_quote: The XM30 program is a mechanized infantry combat vehicle program for the Army that will replace the M2 Bradley Infantry Fighting Vehicle. This optionally manned platform ... higher volume on the XM30 program

claims.source_quote: In 2025, we were competitively awarded construction of an additional DDG-51 destroyer (DDG-148), bringing our total backlog to 11 ships with scheduled deliveries through 2032 ... add Conventional Prompt Strike hypersonic missile strike capability to the DDG-1000
